opportunities.name: United flight search by origin, destination, dates and travelers
opportunities.description: Fill the United Book-a-flight form with an origin airport, destination airport, departure and return dates, traveler counts and cabin, then run Find flights. The user did this about seven times with different city pairs.
steps: Open the United homepage and select the Book tab (Flight).
Click the 'From' field, type the origin city or airport code, and choose the matching suggested-search entry.
Click the 'To' field, type the destination city or airport code, and choose the matching suggested-search entry.
Optionally set the trip type (Roundtrip or One-way) and tick 'Book with miles' or 'Flexible dates'.
Click 'Dates', choose the departure date (use next-month arrows as needed), then the return date if roundtrip.
Open the Travelers control and increase or decrease Adults, Children or Infants to the required counts.
Open the cabin dropdown (Economy / Premium economy / Business) and choose the cabin.
Click 'Find flights'.

instances.values: Sacramento SMF to Houston IAH, one-way, Book with miles, May 12 changed to Jun 02, 1 adult; then Find flights.
Baltimore BWI to New York NYC (search typed as 'NYC'), roundtrip, May 12-14.

opportunities.name: SpotHero event parking search and booking
opportunities.description: Search SpotHero for parking at a venue, pick a scheduled event, set entry and exit times and optional filters, then book the top lot. Repeated for three different venues and events.
steps: Click the 'Search for parking' box, type the venue name, and choose the matching venue suggestion.
Click the matching event in the venue's event list (use the date picker first if the list needs one).
Optionally open Filter, tick an accessibility option (e.g., Wheelchair Accessible), and click 'Show N Results'.
Set 'Enter After' / 'Exit Before' times using the Start Time and End Time selects.
Optionally change Sort by to Distance or Price.
Click 'Update Search'.
Click 'Book Now' on the chosen lot.

instances.values: Barclays Center; event Orlando Magic at Brooklyn Nets (Apr 07); sort by distance; start 3:00 PM, end 5:00 PM; booked 201 S Portland Ave lot.
Busch Stadium, St. Louis; event Pittsburgh Pirates at St. Louis Cardinals (Apr 13); Wheelchair Accessible filter, 10 results; sort by price.
Barclays Center; event Philadelphia 76ers at Brooklyn Nets (Apr 09); Wheelchair Accessible filter, 18 results; start 10:00 AM, end 5:00 PM, Update Search.

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor restaurant search by destination with cuisine filter
opportunities.description: Search Tripadvisor for a destination, open its restaurant listings, apply a cuisine or feature filter, and open a restaurant.
steps: Click 'Restaurants' in the Tripadvisor top nav.
Type the destination into the search box and choose the matching suggestion.
On the restaurant listing, click 'Show more' under Cuisine or Restaurant features.
Tick the wanted cuisine or feature checkbox (e.g., Italian, Indian, Outdoor Seating).
Click 'Apply' if a modal is shown, or confirm the filter.
Open a restaurant from the results (Order online / Menu / restaurant name).

instances.values: Central Park New York; cuisine filter Italian; opened Central Park restaurants.
Los Angeles; cuisine filter Indian; Apply; 'limit search to Los Angeles' link; then opened a restaurant listing.
Big Sur, CA; feature filter Outdoor Seating.

opportunities.name: Amtrak Vacations quote request form
opportunities.description: Submit an Amtrak Vacations 'Instant Quote' request: pick a trip (departure city, date, cabin/sleeper), traveler counts and an occasion note, then enter contact details and submit.
steps: Click 'Instant Quote' on the Amtrak Vacations trip page.
Type the departure city in 'What city would you like to depart from?'.
Tick the reverse-trip checkbox if wanted.
Tick the sleeper/accommodation option (e.g., Deluxe Bedroom) and click 'Continue'.
Pick the preferred travel date in the calendar and click 'Continue'.
Set adult and child counts and type the special-occasion note in 'About Your Trip'; click 'Continue'.
Enter first name, last name, email and phone; choose the advisor option ('I am NOT a Travel Advisor.').
Click 'Submit Quote Request'.

instances.values: Chicago departure; reverse trip checked; Deluxe Bedroom; date 22 selected; 2 adults; note 'Wedding Anniversary'.
Name John Mark, johnmark@gmail.com, phone 234567890, not a travel advisor, submitted.

opportunities.name: Tripadvisor Reco trip designer intake wizard
opportunities.description: Run the Tripadvisor Reco trip-designer questionnaire for a destination: search the destination, Get Started, choose dates, occasion, travelers, budget, activities, and vibe, moving through Next at each step.
steps: Type the destination in the Reco 'Where to?' box and choose the suggestion.
Click 'Get Started'.
Select the start and end dates in the calendar (use next-month arrows) and click 'Next'.
Pick an occasion chip (e.g., Family Vacation) and click 'Next'.
Adjust adult and child counts; enter each child's age; click 'Next'.
Pick a budget range from the From and To dropdowns and click 'Next'.
Pick one or more activity chips and click 'Next'.
Pick a travel-vibe chip and click 'Next'.

instances.values: Egypt; Jul 01 - Jul 04 2023; occasion Family Vacation; 2 adults + 1 child aged 8; budget $4,000-$6,000.
Egypt; budget $4,000-$6,000 (To $6,000); activities Must See Attractions, Local Cuisine, History.
Egypt; activity Indigenous People & Traditions; vibe Adventurous; Next.

opportunities.name: United explore-destinations map search by origin
opportunities.description: Use United's Explore destinations map: type an origin, pick its suggestion, set roundtrip and date options, then Search to see cheapest fares on the map.
steps: Type the origin city in 'Flying from' on the Explore destinations page.
Choose the matching suggestion.
Set the trip type (Roundtrip) and click 'Flexible dates' if wanted.
Click 'Search' to show the fares on the map.

instances.values: Origin Phoenix (PHX); Search.
Origin Las Vegas (LAS); Roundtrip; Flexible dates; Search.
